meta.conventions: negative feedback v = -K y in decoupled channels; u = [A, n] v; ZOH; GM absolute and dB; PM deg; rad/s; 20 ms averaged accelerometer tilt available one step later; extra input delay delay_steps

separation.note: decentralised stability is guaranteed if mu(E T_d) < 1 (E = (G - G_d) G_d^-1, T_d = diagonal complementary sensitivity, Grosdidier-Morari); quasi-static n^T S A = 0 for any pad stiffness (attitude/heave commands do not change the twist load)

twist_deadband.verdict: no limit cycle (dead-band DF is real in [0, 1); needs |L| >= 1 at a phase crossing)

saturation_gain_sweep.verdict: stable for every uniform gain reduction -> no saturation limit cycle (DF)

bryson_quasistatic.assumption: x_max = 0.2 deg (accuracy), v_max per channel = v_max / max|A_i,j| (one leg at v_max)
bryson_quasistatic.note: LQR on the quasi-static integrator plant returns a diagonal P(I) law = the C2 structure; the Bryson bandwidth is 10-12x the C2 crossover and is not reachable with the attitude filter (rocking).

assumptions.performance: phi, theta / 0.2 deg, n^T P / 5 kN, clearance / 5 mm
assumptions.QN: leg speed noise 5 % v_max on the inputs
assumptions.RN: IMU 100 ug/rtHz over 20 ms, pressure 0.3 kN, stroke 0.1 mm
assumptions.design_model: top auger, pads, beta 1.0, rigid mast; no input delay
